detailed_descriptions.en: AN ACTION ROGUELITE WITH A BOUNCING BULLET BALL In a sun-scorched future, the Furyball , a new bloody sport rules one of the last bastions of civilization. You are an outsider from the slums, armed with a Furyball and with nothing to lose. You have one night to cross a city ruled by dangerous sports gangs and reach the Furydome for your final battle. Master your Furyball, upgrade your gear, create unstoppable combos of rebounds and kick some asses with your ball! BOUNCE YOUR WAY TO VICTORY To fight across Neo-Arcadia, you can only trust your loyal Furyball. Use good positioning and clever timing to launch your Furyball at neck-breaking speed. Harness the chaos…or die trying! TONS OF BUILDS Each new run is an opportunity to create and discover new strategies and combos by modding your Furyball with tons of unique modules! Burn, crush, bleed, and destroy your enemies by fusing and combining modules to create brand new synergies! EVER EVOLVING, EVER CHANGING Explore Neo-Arcadia across several districts filled with dozens of deadly, pinball-inspired arenas! Death is but an opportunity! Unlock and upgrade new equipment to further customize your build and wreak havoc through the streets! Each run is a unique odyssey full of possibilities. A CITADEL CRAWLING WITH GANGS Battle your way through a city ruled by unique sport-obsessed gangs! Each with their own style, tricks, and deadly quirks. Adapt your build, shift your playstyle, and crush the boss of every district! GRINDHOUSE RETROFUTURIST APOCALYPSE A hardcore odyssey through a gritty wasteland dripping with 70s retrofuturist flair, backed by a discopunk soundtrack from Toxic Avenger. Think Tarantino’s Grindhouse - homage to exploitation films of the 1970’s - mixed with Mad Max and Rollerball! Wishlist to get notified. Follow to see announcements. Join our Discord to help us create the first " Rogue Beat'em Ball"! Rebound Team.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
AN ACTION ROGUELITE WITH A BOUNCING BULLET BALL

In a sun-scorched future, the Furyball, a new bloody sport rules one of the last bastions of civilization. 

You are an outsider from the slums, armed with a Furyball and with nothing to lose. You have one night to cross a city ruled by dangerous sports gangs and reach the Furydome for your final battle. 

Master your Furyball, upgrade your gear, create unstoppable combos of rebounds and kick some asses with your ball! 

BOUNCE YOUR WAY TO VICTORY

To fight across Neo-Arcadia, you can only trust your loyal Furyball. Use good positioning and clever timing to launch your Furyball at neck-breaking speed. Harness the chaos…or die trying!

TONS OF BUILDS

Each new run is an opportunity to create and discover new strategies and combos by modding your Furyball with tons of unique modules! Burn, crush, bleed, and destroy your enemies by fusing and combining modules to create brand new synergies!

EVER EVOLVING, EVER CHANGING

Explore Neo-Arcadia across several districts filled with dozens of deadly, pinball-inspired arenas! Death is but an opportunity! Unlock and upgrade new equipment to further customize your build and wreak havoc through the streets! Each run is a unique odyssey full of possibilities.

A CITADEL CRAWLING WITH GANGS

Battle your way through a city ruled by unique sport-obsessed gangs! Each with their own style, tricks, and deadly quirks. Adapt your build, shift your playstyle, and crush the boss of every district!

GRINDHOUSE RETROFUTURIST APOCALYPSE

A hardcore odyssey through a gritty wasteland dripping with 70s retrofuturist flair, backed by a discopunk soundtrack from Toxic Avenger. Think Tarantino’s Grindhouse - homage to exploitation films of the 1970’s - mixed with Mad Max and Rollerball! 

Wishlist to get notified. Follow to see announcements. Join our Discord to help us create the first "Rogue Beat'em Ball"!

Rebound Team.
